project.name: cargotracker
project.description: Django-based cargo tracking application structured in domain-driven layers (cargo, handling, location, voyage).

nodes.name: map_status.py
nodes.summary: Maps a cargo's routing and delivery state to a status code string used by the tracking map.

nodes.name: map_status_code
nodes.summary: Returns NOT_ROUTED, AT_DESTINATION, MISDIRECTED or the transport status value for a cargo.

nodes.name: tracking.py
nodes.summary: Application service that looks up cargos and their handling histories through the cargo and handling repositories.

nodes.name: TrackingLookup
nodes.summary: Coordinates cargo and handling event repositories to find a cargo by tracking ID and build its handling history.

nodes.name: composition.py
nodes.summary: Composition root wiring concrete Django repositories into the tracking lookup service and view.

nodes.name: compose_tracking_view
nodes.summary: Builds the tracking view with a TrackingLookup backed by Django repositories.

nodes.name: cargo.py
nodes.summary: Defines the Cargo aggregate root combining tracking ID, route specification, delivery and itinerary.

nodes.name: Cargo
nodes.summary: Cargo aggregate root with identity-based equality on its tracking ID, exposing origin, route, delivery and itinerary.

nodes.name: repository.py
nodes.summary: Declares the abstract CargoRepository port for persisting and querying cargos.

nodes.name: CargoRepository
nodes.summary: Repository interface with upsert, find and find_all operations for Cargo.

nodes.name: tracking_id.py
nodes.summary: Value object for a cargo tracking identifier with validation.

nodes.name: TrackingId
nodes.summary: Immutable tracking ID value object that validates its value on creation and renders as a string.

nodes.name: forms.py
nodes.summary: Django form for entering a tracking ID with required-field message and styled input widget.

nodes.name: TrackingForm
nodes.summary: Django Form with a single stripped, required tracking_id text field.

nodes.name: eta.py
nodes.summary: Formats a cargo's estimated time of arrival for display.

nodes.name: format_eta
nodes.summary: Returns a human-readable ETA string derived from the cargo's delivery.

nodes.name: adapter.py
nodes.summary: Adapts a cargo into the query-string URL for the embedded tracking map frame.

nodes.name: map_frame_url
nodes.summary: Builds the map frame URL with status code and origin, destination and last-known location codes and names.

nodes.name: next_activity.py
nodes.summary: Renders the next expected handling activity as display text.

nodes.name: get_next_activity_text
nodes.summary: Converts a HandlingActivity into descriptive text for the tracking page.

nodes.name: status_text.py
nodes.summary: Produces human-readable status text for a cargo based on its transport status.

nodes.name: get_status_text
nodes.summary: Returns status text such as 'In port X' or 'Onboard voyage N', falling back to a lookup table.

nodes.name: views.py
nodes.summary: Django view factory handling tracking form submission and assembling cargo status, ETA, map and history context for rendering.

nodes.name: create_tracking_view
nodes.summary: Returns a track view that validates the form, looks up the cargo and renders a full page or HTMX partial.

nodes.name: urls.py
nodes.summary: Root Django URL configuration routing the tracking page and including the tracking map URLs.

nodes.name: models.py
nodes.summary: Django ORM models persisting cargo aggregates and their itinerary legs, with foreign keys to location, voyage and handling event records.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses related_name='+' and string-based foreign keys to avoid circular imports and reverse accessors across apps.

nodes.name: CargoRecord
nodes.summary: Django model for the 'cargo' table storing tracking id, route specification, delivery progress, next expected handling and last event references.

nodes.name: LegRecord
nodes.summary: Django model for the 'leg' table representing one itinerary leg of a cargo with voyage, load/unload locations and times, ordered by load time.

nodes.name: history.py
nodes.summary: Presentation helpers that turn a cargo's handling history into human-readable rows with descriptions, formatted UTC times and an expected-event flag.

nodes.name: get_event_description
nodes.summary: Formats a handling event into a sentence using a per-event-type template with location and voyage number.

nodes.name: get_history_rows
nodes.summary: Builds display rows for each handling event, including description, formatted completion time and whether the cargo itinerary expected the event.

nodes.name: models.py
nodes.summary: Django app models module that re-exports the cargo infrastructure records so Django discovers them.

nodes.name: handling_event.py
nodes.summary: Domain entity for cargo handling events (load, unload, receive, claim, customs) with validation of types and voyage requirements.
nodes.languageNotes: Frozen dataclass normalizing fields via object.__setattr__ in __post_init__; StrEnum for event types.

nodes.name: HandlingEventType
nodes.summary: String enum of handling event kinds, indicating which kinds (load/unload) require a voyage.

nodes.name: HandlingEvent
nodes.summary: Immutable handling event of a cargo at a location and time, validating types, UTC timestamps and voyage consistency on construction.

nodes.name: handling_history.py
nodes.summary: Domain value object holding a cargo's deduplicated handling events sorted by completion time, with an EMPTY singleton.

nodes.name: HandlingHistory
nodes.summary: Immutable chronologically sorted collection of unique handling events, exposing the most recent event.

nodes.name: repository.py
nodes.summary: Defines the HandlingEventRepository protocol, the domain port for storing handling events and looking up a cargo's history.

nodes.name: HandlingEventRepository
nodes.summary: Protocol declaring store, upsert and lookup_handling_history_of_cargo operations for handling events.

nodes.name: models.py
nodes.summary: Django ORM model for handling events, linking to cargo, location and optional voyage records.

nodes.name: HandlingEventRecord
nodes.summary: Django model mapped to the 'HandlingEvent' table storing event type, times and foreign keys to voyage, location and cargo.

nodes.name: repository.py
nodes.summary: Django ORM implementation of the handling event repository, mapping between domain events and database records.

nodes.name: DjangoHandlingEventRepository
nodes.summary: Stores, upserts and retrieves handling events via Django ORM, rebuilding domain cargo, location and voyage objects when loading history.

nodes.name: models.py
nodes.summary: Django app models module re-exporting handling infrastructure records for model discovery.

nodes.name: models.py
nodes.summary: Django ORM model for voyages identified by voyage number.

nodes.name: VoyageRecord
nodes.summary: Django model mapped to the 'voyage' table holding the voyage number.

nodes.name: models.py
nodes.summary: Django app models module re-exporting voyage infrastructure records for model discovery.

nodes.name: sample_data.py
nodes.summary: Defines the characterized sample dataset (locations, voyages, cargos with routes and handling events) and a seeder that persists it through repository interfaces and derives each cargo's delivery.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses frozen dataclass seed records and date arithmetic helpers to build deterministic data relative to a given day.

nodes.name: SampleDataSeeder
nodes.summary: Seeds locations, voyages, cargos and handling events via injected repositories, then recalculates each cargo's delivery from its handling history.

nodes.name: _cargo_from_seed
nodes.summary: Builds a Cargo aggregate from a seed record, resolving locations and voyages, constructing route specification, itinerary and initial delivery.

nodes.name: _LegSeed
nodes.summary: Data record describing one itinerary leg in the sample data.

nodes.name: _EventSeed
nodes.summary: Data record describing one handling event in the sample data.

nodes.name: _CargoSeed
nodes.summary: Data record describing a sample cargo with its route, legs and handling events.

nodes.name: seed_sample_data.py
nodes.summary: Django management command that wires Django-backed repositories into SampleDataSeeder and seeds sample data in a single transaction.

nodes.name: Command
nodes.summary: Management command whose handle method seeds the characterized sample data atomically relative to today's date.

nodes.name: carrier_movement.py
nodes.summary: Defines the CarrierMovement value object representing a single voyage leg between two locations with departure and arrival times.

nodes.name: CarrierMovement
nodes.summary: Immutable value object for a carrier's movement between departure and arrival locations, validated on construction.

nodes.name: repository.py
nodes.summary: Declares the VoyageRepository abstraction for persisting and retrieving voyages.

nodes.name: VoyageRepository
nodes.summary: Repository interface offering upsert, find and find_all operations for Voyage aggregates.

nodes.name: schedule.py
nodes.summary: Defines the Schedule value object, an ordered collection of carrier movements with an EMPTY constant.

nodes.name: Schedule
nodes.summary: Value object holding a voyage's carrier movements, normalizing and validating them on construction.

nodes.name: voyage.py
nodes.summary: Defines the Voyage entity identified by its voyage number and carrying a schedule.

nodes.name: Voyage
nodes.summary: Voyage entity with identity-based equality and hashing on its voyage number, holding a Schedule.

nodes.name: voyage_builder.py
nodes.summary: Provides a fluent builder that assembles a Voyage from successive carrier movements chained between locations.

nodes.name: VoyageBuilder
nodes.summary: Builder that tracks the current location and accumulates carrier movements, producing a Voyage on build.

nodes.name: voyage_number.py
nodes.summary: Defines the VoyageNumber value object identifying a voyage.

nodes.name: VoyageNumber
nodes.summary: Validated identifier value object for a voyage, rendered as its string value.

nodes.name: repository.py
nodes.summary: Django ORM implementation of the VoyageRepository, mapping VoyageRecord rows to domain Voyage objects.

nodes.name: DjangoVoyageRepository
nodes.summary: Persists and loads voyages through the Django ORM and converts records back to domain objects.

nodes.name: dates.py
nodes.summary: Tiny helper that normalizes datetimes to UTC for the cargo domain.

nodes.name: as_utc
nodes.summary: Converts a datetime to a timezone-aware UTC datetime, treating naive values as UTC.

nodes.name: delivery.py
nodes.summary: Delivery value object that derives a cargo's transport, routing and misdirection status, ETA, last known location and next expected activity from its route specification, itinerary and last handling activity.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses dataclass-style value objects and enums with a derived_from factory that computes all state at construction.

nodes.name: TransportStatus
nodes.summary: Enumeration of where a cargo is in transport (e.g. not received, in port, onboard carrier, claimed).

nodes.name: RoutingStatus
nodes.summary: Enumeration describing whether a cargo is not routed, routed or misrouted.

nodes.name: Delivery
nodes.summary: Immutable snapshot of a cargo's delivery progress, derived from route specification, itinerary and the last handling event, including misdirection, ETA and next expected activity.

nodes.name: handling_activity.py
nodes.summary: Value object pairing a handling event type with a location and optional voyage, used for last and next expected activity.

nodes.name: HandlingActivity
nodes.summary: Describes a handling activity (type, location, voyage) and validates that voyage presence matches the event type.

nodes.name: itinerary.py
nodes.summary: Itinerary aggregate part holding an ordered list of legs and checking whether handling events match the planned route.

nodes.name: Itinerary
nodes.summary: Ordered sequence of legs that decides if a handling activity (receive, load, unload, claim) is expected along the planned route.

nodes.name: leg.py
nodes.summary: Leg value object representing one voyage segment between two locations with load and unload times.

nodes.name: Leg
nodes.summary: A single carrier leg with voyage, load/unload locations and times, validated on creation.

nodes.name: route_specification.py
nodes.summary: Route specification value object holding origin, destination and arrival deadline, and checking itineraries against them.

nodes.name: RouteSpecification
nodes.summary: Specifies a cargo's origin, destination and arrival deadline and tests whether an itinerary satisfies them.

nodes.name: repository.py
nodes.summary: Django ORM-backed implementation of the cargo repository that persists cargo aggregates and maps database records back to domain objects.
nodes.languageNotes: Maps between Django model records and immutable domain objects, normalizing datetimes to UTC.

nodes.name: DjangoCargoRepository
nodes.summary: Implements CargoRepository with upsert, find and find_all operations, translating CargoRecord/LegRecord rows to Cargo, Itinerary, Leg, Location and Voyage domain objects.

nodes.name: location.py
nodes.summary: Location domain entity identified by UN/LOCODE with a name and validation on construction.

nodes.name: Location
nodes.summary: A port or place identified by a UnLocode and a name; validates its fields and renders as a string.

nodes.name: repository.py
nodes.summary: Defines the domain-level LocationRepository protocol (upsert, find, find_all) that abstracts persistence of Location entities.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses typing.Protocol for structural typing of the repository interface.

nodes.name: LocationRepository
nodes.summary: Protocol describing how locations are stored and retrieved by UN/LOCODE.

nodes.name: un_locode.py
nodes.summary: Defines the UnLocode value object that validates and normalizes UN/LOCODE location identifiers.
nodes.languageNotes: Frozen dataclass using object.__setattr__ in __post_init__ to normalize to uppercase.

nodes.name: UnLocode
nodes.summary: Immutable value object that validates a UN/LOCODE against a regex and stores it uppercased.

nodes.name: models.py
nodes.summary: Django ORM model persisting locations in the 'location' table.

nodes.name: LocationRecord
nodes.summary: Django model with unlocode and name columns mapped to the 'location' table.

nodes.name: repository.py
nodes.summary: Django ORM implementation of the LocationRepository, mapping LocationRecord rows to domain Location objects.

nodes.name: DjangoLocationRepository
nodes.summary: Implements upsert, find and find_all for locations using LocationRecord and converts records to domain entities.

nodes.name: models.py
nodes.summary: Re-exports LocationRecord so Django discovers the location app's model at the conventional models module.

nodes.name: coordinates.py
nodes.summary: Static lookup table mapping UN/LOCODE location codes to latitude/longitude pairs used for placing cargo markers on the tracking map.

nodes.name: urls.py
nodes.summary: Django URL configuration routing requests for the tracking map frame to its view.

nodes.name: views.py
nodes.summary: Django view that builds map marker data from query parameters (origin, destination, last known location) and renders the embeddable map frame template, coloring the last-known marker by cargo status.

nodes.name: map_frame
nodes.summary: Reads location and status query parameters, builds marker dicts with coordinates and colors for known location codes, and renders the map frame template; allows same-origin framing.

nodes.name: _location_data
nodes.summary: Extracts the code and name of a location role from the request query string.

layers.name: Domain Layer
layers.description: Core business model: aggregates, entities, value objects and repository interfaces for cargo, handling, location and voyage.

layers.name: Application Layer
layers.description: Use-case services, sample data and management commands that orchestrate domain logic.

layers.name: Infrastructure Layer
layers.description: Django ORM models, repository implementations and database migrations.

layers.name: Interface Layer
layers.description: Views, forms, URL routes and presentation adapters for the tracking UI and map.

layers.name: Templates
layers.description: Django HTML templates rendering the tracking pages and map frame.

layers.name: Configuration & Wiring
layers.description: Django settings, root URLs, ASGI/WSGI entry points, app configs, package markers and the composition root.

tour.title: Project Overview: the Handling Glossary
tour.description: Start with the ubiquitous language of the cargo tracking domain: handling events (load, unload, receive, claim), cargo, voyages and locations. These terms appear throughout the code.

tour.title: Entry Point: URLs and Settings
tour.description: urls.py routes the tracking page and includes the map frame URLs. settings.py registers the four apps (cargo, handling, location, voyage), templates and middleware.

tour.title: Server Entry Points
tour.description: ASGI and WSGI expose the Django application to production servers.

tour.title: The Cargo Aggregate
tour.description: Cargo is the aggregate root, combining TrackingId, RouteSpecification, Itinerary and Delivery. These value objects model what a shipment is and where it should go.

tour.title: Handling Events and History
tour.description: Handling events record what happened to a cargo. HandlingHistory keeps them deduplicated and sorted, and Delivery derives status from them.

tour.title: Locations and Voyages
tour.description: Locations are identified by UN/LOCODE. Voyages are made of schedules of carrier movements, assembled with a fluent builder.

tour.title: Repository Ports
tour.description: The domain declares abstract repositories (ports) so business logic does not depend on Django.

tour.title: Infrastructure: ORM Models and Repositories
tour.description: Django ORM records and repository implementations (adapters) map between domain objects and database rows. Migrations create the tables.

tour.title: Application Services and Composition Root
tour.description: The tracking service looks up cargo and its history through the ports. The composition root wires in the concrete Django repositories.

tour.title: Interface Layer: Tracking View
tour.description: The view factory handles the form, calls the tracking service and uses presenters for status, ETA, next activity and history.

tour.title: Templates and the Map Frame
tour.description: HTMX-enabled templates render results. The map frame embeds a Leaflet map fed by adapter, URL, view and coordinates modules.

tour.title: Sample Data and Seeding
tour.description: A management command seeds the characterized sample dataset so you can try the app.
